artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan for the new /books --review/--revise command, mirroring /distill's three-layer sub-mode split in the books extension source store.

memory_candidates.content: This agent system has a reusable three-layer shape for a slash command with many sub-modes, proven twice (memory's /distill, books' /books): (1) commands/<name>.md parses flags into a single sub_mode value and declares the delegation payload once; (2) a single direct-execution skill holds a 'Shared Sub-Mode Skeleton' section stating the common seven-step shape ONCE with generic placeholders, plus one-line stub pointers of the exact form 'READ <pattern-file> now and follow it exactly.'; (3) one context pattern file per sub-mode is 'the COMPLETE and ONLY specification' for that sub-mode, stating only its deltas from the skeleton. Sanctioned skeleton deviations (e.g. a read-only sub-mode skipping the MANDATORY-STOP interactive step) are stated explicitly in the skeleton's own text, never left as a silent omission. Because AskUserQuestion is not reachable from a dispatched subagent on this harness, every interactive gate must live inline in the direct-execution skill body; only non-interactive research or aggregation may be delegated. When adding such a command to an existing extension, note EXTENSION.md's hard 60-line Rule U cap: an extension already at 60 lines requires compression in the same change that adds a table row.
